reviews.evidence: The shared token client is configured at 4 requests/second normally, 6 in development, with retry limit 5. Installed @storyblok/api-client/dist/utils/rate-limit.mjs confirms requestsPerSecond config uses a fixed shared queue. Overflow relation batches contain at most 50 IDs and intentionally stop on the first error/missing-data result before later requests are started. Canonical recipe explicitly retains sequential execution for rate-limited services and prior-outcome-dependent error handling.
reviews.impact: Parallelism might reduce latency under some workloads, but is not established as a safe improvement here. Starting siblings would change fail-stop behavior and consume requests after an earlier failure. No production speedup or no-speedup claim made.
